children: LEXINGTON, Mass., Oct. 20, 2026
-- Rapid Micro Biosystems, Inc.

(the “Company”), an innovative life sciences technology company providing mission-critical automation solutions to facilitate the efficient manufacturing and fast, safe release of healthcare products, today announced its participation as a sponsor of the PDA Pharmaceutical Microbiology Conference 2026, taking place in Washington, D.C. from October 26-28.

The conference brings together microbiology professionals, quality leaders and regulatory experts from across the pharmaceutical industry to share practical experience, emerging technologies and evolving regulatory perspectives shaping the future of pharmaceutical microbiology.
“We are encouraged by the rapidly growing industry focus on modernizing microbial quality control through greater automation, digitalization and data integrity,”
said Robert Spignesi, President and Chief Executive Officer of Rapid Micro Biosystems.

“Seeing the Growth Direct® platform as the focal point of multiple conference presentations from leading top 20 pharmaceutical companies reflects the increasingly important role that full automation and data-driven quality operations are playing with respect to automating mission critical workflows, regulatory compliance and standardization. We look forward to engaging with customers and industry experts as they share practical experiences leveraging automation to advance quality and operational efficiency across their organizations.”
Attendees are invited to visit
Rapid Micro Biosystems at
Booth 101: Explore the Future of Microbial QC
and learn how leading pharmaceutical manufacturers are modernizing microbial quality control through automation and digitalization with the Growth Direct platform.
As part of the conference program, Rapid Micro Biosystems technologies will be featured in a presentation by Sophia Pfeiffer, Head of Modern Microbial Technologies at Boehringer Ingelheim:
Evaluation of RMBNucleus™ Mold Alarm – Growth Direct System: Leveraging Computer Vision and AI for Early Detection of Mold Contamination – Monday, October 26, 1:10 p.m. ET

Additional conference presentations will explore how automated rapid microbiological methods using the Growth Direct platform can strengthen data integrity, inspection readiness and regulatory compliance. These sessions will also share real-world experiences implementing standardized and automated microbiology workflows with the Growth Direct platform, including considerations for accelerating adoption and improving efficiency across environmental monitoring and bioburden testing programs.

The Growth Direct platform is the industry’s leading fully automated, non-destructive, growth-based platform for microbial quality control testing. The platform delivers faster time to results, improved data integrity, enhanced accuracy, and greater operational efficiency across environmental monitoring, water testing, bioburden, and sterility applications.

About Rapid Micro Biosystems

Rapid Micro Biosystems is an innovative life sciences technology company providing mission critical automation solutions to facilitate the efficient manufacturing and fast, safe release of healthcare products such as biologics, vaccines, cell and gene therapies, and sterile injectables. The Company’s flagship Growth Direct system automates and modernizes the antiquated, manual microbial quality control (“MQC”) testing workflows used in the largest and most complex pharmaceutical manufacturing operations across the globe. The Growth Direct system brings the quality control lab to the manufacturing floor, unlocking the power of MQC automation to deliver the faster results, greater accuracy, increased operational efficiency, better compliance with data integrity regulations, and quicker decision making that customers rely on to ensure safe and consistent supply of important healthcare products. The Company is headquartered in Lexington, Massachusetts and has U.S. manufacturing in Lowell, Massachusetts, with global locations in Switzerland, Germany, and the Netherlands. For more information, please visit www.rapidmicrobio.com or follow the Company on X (formerly known as Twitter) at @rapidmicrobio or on LinkedIn.
